Since 2003, reached out to 15+ million people and directly impacted 4, 00,000+ lives of people affected by leprosy. Specialization in community based disease prevention, control, policy advocacy and health-care for communities affected by Neglected Tropical Diseases(NTDs) / infectious diseases, especially: Leprosy, TB and HIV/AIDS. ALERT’s team consists of 500+ qualified, experienced medical and program personnel reaching out to underserved and building lives. We produce, supply leprosy aids & appliances to 12 states. ALERT is a Partner NGO with: Government of India; Maharashtra and Jharkhand. An ‘Assured Partner’ of Give India and has Validation by GuideStar India. Six National workshops in collaboration with the government, WHO and other stakeholders: leprosy control; best practices; integration; quality care; inclusion and urban leprosy. Published document series on policy and programmatic aspects. --> Donor Testimonial A very good initiative for People suffering from leprosy; Very humbling experience being with great individuals dedicated to social cause; It is a secular non government organisation working for leprosy affected people. All staffs are proper trained and experts in this field.
